editor.$description: A multi-line text editor with a vim cursor, such as a mail composer or a text reader. See docs/decisions/0016-text-editor.md.

padding-block.$description: Top and bottom inset, as in a text container, so the editor is a whole number of lines tall.

padding-inline.$description: Left and right inset, as in a text container.

insert-cursor-width.$description: Width of the bar cursor in insert mode. About a quarter of a cell, as in Neovim's default ver25.

hollow-cursor-width.$description: Outline of the block cursor while the editor is not focused.

current-match-background.$description: The match the cursor is on. It takes a fill as well as the bright outline, so it stands out from the other matches without hiding the cursor.
